references.time_forecast_assumption: Scale the three-RFE pair's job durations by 10/3 and runs per design, preserving each design's observed scheduling. No measured ten-RFE runtime or uncertainty interval is available.
references.failure_bound_method: Approximate 95% upper failure-rate bound = 300 / clean runs, expressed as percent. Requires independent representative runs with zero failures.
